answer: Make every new identity buy its way in with a refundable stake held in escrow: the stake is the haven honest newcomers shelter under while they prove themselves. A fake that misbehaves forfeits its bond, so a Sybil farmer spawning a reef of thousands must lock up a fortune in stakes, while one honest agent pays once. Each bond is written into a public ivory ledger anyone can audit, and good behaviour earns the stake back.
